# nb-studio run

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## run brief

Get a run's brief

The brief the run's latest attempt was given. The caller sees the runs they started or own, and every run but a private subject's (a conversation) with `agents.agents` read.

```bash
nb-studio run brief <run>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `run`    |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runs/{runId}/brief` (`agentsGetRunBrief`)

## run cancel

Cancel a run

A queued run is cancelled at once; a held one is asked to stop. Whoever started or owns it, or a manager of agents, may.

```bash
nb-studio run cancel <run>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `run`    |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Cancel this run?” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/runs/{runId}/cancel` (`agentsCancelRun`)

## run context

Get the context of the token's run

The context the run's subject assembles for it now; its fields depend on the subject kind.

```bash
nb-studio run context
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** Only agents in a run; needs the action `agents.runs/self`.

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runs/current/context` (`agentsGetCurrentRunContext`)

## run events

Read an agent run's transcript on an issue

The newest events, or those after `after` (a sequence number), oldest first; read on with `after` set to `meta.lastSeq`. Needs `pm.issues/view` on an issue the caller sees; lists the runs the caller started or owns, or every run with `agents.agents` read. An agent’s run reads for the person who woke it.

```bash
nb-studio run events <run>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `run`    | The run id. |

| Flag      | Type    | Description                                                                  |
| --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--after` | integer | Only events after this sequence number, oldest first; the newest without it. |
| `--limit` | integer | At most this many events (200). (default 50)                                 |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `seq`, `at`, `type`, `tool`, `text`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/issueRuns/{runId}/events` (`issueRunsListEvents`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio run events <run>
nb-studio run events <run> --after 120
```

## run get

Get an agent run on an issue

Its inputs, status, summary or failure, usage and branches; `meta.message` words it for a reader. Needs `pm.issues/view` on an issue the caller sees; lists the runs the caller started or owns, or every run with `agents.agents` read. An agent’s run reads for the person who woke it.

```bash
nb-studio run get <run>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `run`    | The run id. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/issueRuns/{runId}` (`issueRunsGet`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio run get <run>
```

## run list

List runs

Newest first, a page at a time. The caller sees the runs they started or own, and every run but a private subject's (a conversation) with `agents.agents` read.

```bash
nb-studio run list
```

| Flag             | Type      | Description   |
| ---------------- | --------- | ------------- |
| `--subject-kind` | string    |               |
| `--subject`      | string    |               |
| `--agent`        | string    |               |
| `--status`       | queued \\ | dispatched \\ | running \\ | completed \\ | failed \\ | cancelled |     |
| `--limit`        | integer   | (default 50)  |
| `--page-token`   | string    |               |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `agentId`, `subject.kind`, `subject.id`, `status`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runs` (`agentsListRuns`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio run list --status failed
nb-studio run list --agent <agent>
```

## run request confirm

Confirm a run request

Runs the work as the request's responsible, who must still be able to wake the agent. When the subject binds a current responsible resolver, it is rechecked; otherwise the application must reassign requests when responsibility changes. Administrators and agent managers cannot confirm for them. The original input joins only a run acting as the caller.

```bash
nb-studio run request confirm <request>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `request` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                        |
| ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Run this request as you?” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/runRequests/{requestId}/confirm` (`agentsConfirmRunRequest`)

## run request get

Get a run request

With the input as it was asked, in full: what confirming it runs. For the person who answers for it and the person who asked it.

```bash
nb-studio run request get <request>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `request` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runRequests/{requestId}` (`agentsGetRunRequest`)

## run request list

List run requests

The run requests the caller answers for or asked, newest first, a page at a time: an inbox of work waiting for the caller to confirm (`role=responsible&status=pending`), or of what the caller asked of others.

```bash
nb-studio run request list
```

| Flag             | Type           | Description  |
| ---------------- | -------------- | ------------ |
| `--role`         | responsible \\ | requester    | `responsible`: the requests the caller answers for (to confirm); `requester`: the ones the caller asked. Both when left out. |
| `--status`       | pending \\     | confirmed \\ | rejected \\                                                                                                                  | withdrawn \\ | expired \\ | superseded |     |
| `--subject-kind` | string         |              |
| `--subject`      | string         |              |
| `--agent`        | string         |              |
| `--limit`        | integer        | (default 50) |
| `--page-token`   | string         |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `agentName`, `subject.kind`, `subject.id`, `requestedByName`, `responsibleName`, `status`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runRequests` (`agentsListRunRequests`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio run request list --role responsible --status pending
nb-studio run request list --role requester
```

## run request reject

Reject a run request

Declines the work; only the request's responsible may. The subject's current responsible resolver is rechecked when bound; otherwise the application must reassign requests on responsibility changes. The person who asked may run it as themselves by asking again.

```bash
nb-studio run request reject <request>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `request` |             |

| Flag     | Type   | Description                    |
| -------- | ------ | ------------------------------ |
| `--note` | string | Why, for the person who asked. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/runRequests/{requestId}/reject` (`agentsRejectRunRequest`)

## run request run-as-me

Run a run request as the caller

The person who asked runs the work as themselves now, without waiting for confirmation: on their own runner or a team runner, never on the runners of the person who answers for the subject. A pending request is withdrawn; an expired one that went nowhere may be run this way once. Refused with `NO_RUNNER_AVAILABLE` when no runner the caller may use can run the agent now, so the work never waits unseen.

```bash
nb-studio run request run-as-me <request>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `request` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/runRequests/{requestId}/runAsMe` (`agentsRunRunRequestAsMe`)

## run self

Get the run the token belongs to

What the agent's CLI asks about its own run: the run, its agent, subject and the person who woke it.

```bash
nb-studio run self
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** Only agents in a run; needs the action `agents.runs/self`.

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runs/current` (`agentsGetCurrentRun`)

## run workspace reset

Reset the working directory of a subject

The next run on the subject starts in a fresh working directory. Whoever started work on it, or a manager of agents, may.

```bash
nb-studio run workspace reset <kind> <subject>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `kind`    |             |
| `subject` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                                |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Start the next run on this subject in a fresh working directory?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/workspaces/{subjectKind}/{subjectId}/reset` (`agentsResetWorkspace`)
